screening_answers.question: How many years of experience do you have with TypeScript, Node, React and SQL?
screening_answers.answer: 3 years as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company, building web apps, internal AI agents and a CRM. Outside work I ship TypeScript, Node, React and PostgreSQL projects with end-to-end API tests.

screening_answers.question: How do you use Cursor or Claude Code in your workflow?
screening_answers.answer: I use Claude Code daily to scaffold, refactor and write tests, then review every diff myself. I hold Claude Code in Action and Claude Code 101, and my projects ship with end-to-end API tests that check AI-written code.

screening_answers.question: How do you keep AI-written code secure and production-grade?
screening_answers.answer: I review diffs, require tests, and add security controls such as nonce-based CSP, HMAC-signed webhooks, input validation and SSRF hardening. I also penetration-tested 5+ live Play Store apps, so I look for the same weaknesses in generated code.

screening_answers.question: What is your experience with AWS?
screening_answers.answer: I have not worked with AWS in production. My deployments use Vercel, Neon and Supabase, with Docker and GitHub Actions. Hands-on cloud and Postgres work transfers well, and I can pick up the AWS basics quickly.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period and expected salary?
screening_answers.answer: Notice period: immediate. I work from Pune (IST, UTC+05:30) and can overlap with US mornings. Expected salary is open to discussion based on the role and total package.
